args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%, failing health checks after the latest deploy. Rolled the service back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east rolled back due to an orchestrator error); a retry completed us-west and eu-west. All regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy (error rate ~0.2%). Root cause of the v2.3.1 failures still needs investigation.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0**:
   - First attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted after us-east, leaving a mixed version state).
   - Retried, which completed the rollback to us-west and eu-west.
   - Confirmed all regions are now on v2.3.0 and **healthy** (error rate down to ~0.2%).

3. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the v2.3.1 failures, the partial-failure/retry during rollback, and the current healthy state — noting that the root cause of the v2.3.1 failures still needs investigation. The incident has paged the on-call engineer.
